newsitem.title: INDIA: INDIAN HEADLINE STOCKS - factors to watch-May 20.
newsitem.headline: INDIAN HEADLINE STOCKS - factors to watch-May 20.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors affecting Indian stock markets on Tuesday morning:
** Indian coalition government's steering committee's meeting on May 25 will consider increasing prices of diesel, kerosene and liquefied petroleum gas, the Economic Times reports
** Several Indian blue-chip firms plan raising foreign loans of up to $100 million after the government relaxed norms in April, the Business Standard says
** Term lending institution Industrial Development Bank of India to prepay $100 million loan with cheaper loan following falling interest rates, the Economic Times reports
** Scooter maker Bajaj Auto announced a bonus issue in the proportion of one share for every share held
** Tobacco conglomerate ITC expected to release 1996/97 (April-March) results after market hours. Analysts expect net profits to rise by about 40 percent
** Indian Aluminium's net profit fell sharply to 591.9 million rupees in 1996/97 from 1.14 billion in 1995/96 due to higher costs, sluggish domestic market and severe shortage of electricity
